# Hard-Stop Contract Checklist: Paradas Duras Claras, Completas e em Linguagem Simples

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, consistency and coverage of the requirements for the hard-stop message contract, the stop registry and the catalog/procedure synchronization.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Hard-stop message contract + registry coverage + catalog/procedure consistency.
**Depth**: Standard.
**Audience**: Reviewer (PR).

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the 10 Hard Stop Contract fields individually identified and ordered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the canonical message template in the spec complete for all 10 fields, including an explicit "Segurança" field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the registry of 16 stops + 2 confirmations complete with code, category, trigger, site and confirmation options? [Completeness, Spec §Registro de Paradas, §FR-002, §FR-031, §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the 20 dictionary terms and their required translations fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the mechanism by which every message references the dictionary specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the 9 critical flags enumerated in the functional requirement, not only in the assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are the "simple language" rules (one idea per sentence, active voice, acronym translation, neutral tone) defined with measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-026–FR-029]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the counting method for the 20-word sentence limit defined for code spans, paths, lists and punctuation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "exact location" defined as a readable section name plus path, field or command? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "at least two options" reconciled with the template's third "when it exists" option and STOP-DER-02's mandatory three? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Are "literal format rule" and "exactly three columns" defined precisely enough to be compared without a specific Markdown renderer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §SC-009, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "stop site" defined precisely enough to decide when the build must fail for a missing code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "no secrets" defined with examples or prohibited patterns? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the "16 stops today" context and the target "15 other stops + STOP-DER-02" reconcile without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §Contexto, §FR-012, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the 19/13/6 and 35/18 counts agree across FR-022, FR-023 and SC-005? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §FR-023, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the STOP-DER-02 requirements agree across derivation, precedence, checklist and provenance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008–FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the confirmation options consistent between FR-031/FR-032 and the Edge Cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, §FR-032, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Does "no new files" explicitly exclude new test files outside the procedure? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Plan]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-002's "100% of reviewed stops" be objectively measured with a defined sample and reviewer? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Are SC-009's "9 defaults and literal format rules" and SC-010's "exactly three columns" measurable with an explicit comparison method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK021 Is SC-012's "JAR contains messages and registry" tied to a named verification mechanism? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, Compliance Constraints]
- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-004's "0 modules and 3 options" explicitly scoped to STOP-DER-02? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary, exception and recovery scenarios defined for all six stop categories (IN, ENV, DER, EXEC, RULE, CONF)? [Coverage, Spec §Registro de Paradas]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the A → B → C → D gate order stated as an invariant, and is the destination-inside-archetype case absolute with no override? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are multiple versions, missing JAR, missing catalog, missing post-processor and missing mandatory file covered by distinct requirements? [Coverage, Spec §STOP-ENV-01–05]
- [ ] CHK026 Are ambiguous entity, same-priority conflict and contract-write failure covered with candidate/source/options requirements? [Coverage, Spec §STOP-DER-01, §STOP-DER-03, §STOP-DER-04]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are empty contract, `{}`, non-object, blank contract, relative path, `~`, end-of-file marker and in-archetype destination each addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §STOP-IN-02, §STOP-IN-04]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the secret-like-key warning distinguished from a hard stop and from the "no secrets" message rule? [Edge Case, Spec §Casos de Borda, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK029 Are pipe-in-code, flag-like backtick terms, backtick paths and new-stop-without-code tied to build requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the invalid-attribute-list stop distinguished from the other attribute warnings (name, type, enum, nested)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §FR-024, Out of Scope]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Are NFR-001 to NFR-004 scoped enough to be verified without implementation choices, including a baseline for build time? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001–NFR-004]
- [ ] CHK032 Is NFR-005's "works from the installed JAR" tied to the 19-file layout and the opt-in check? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-005, Compliance Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Is the catalog's authority over defaults and format reconciled with the procedure's summary? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the README out-of-scope decision consistent with the context's README observations? [Consistency, Spec §Contexto, Out of Scope]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Is the missing "Segurança" label in the spec's canonical template and example resolved against FR-001? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the STOP-ENV-02 trigger compatible with the `archetype-resources/` missing case? [Ambiguity, Spec §STOP-ENV-02, Plan]
- [ ] CHK037 Is History 2's invalid-attribute test compatible with the list-level STOP-DER-02 trigger? [Ambiguity, Spec §História 2, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the exact locations of the catalog description change and the FR-006 explanation specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the opt-in JAR verification property named in the requirement? [Ambiguity, Spec §Compliance Constraints, Plan]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
